input.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total
FROM client c
INNER JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
INNER JOIN account a ON a.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
AND d.A2 = 'Sokolov'
